newsitem.title: UK: James Bond star Moore wins apology from Daily Mail.
newsitem.headline: James Bond star Moore wins apology from Daily Mail.

text.p: James Bond star Roger Moore on Wednesday won an apology from a British newspaper which falsely alleged he made his ex-wife Luisa endure a bitter battle over money following their divorce.
The High Court was told that the tabloid Daily Mail accepted that its article accusing Moore of being "intransigent and unreasonable" in negotiations over the divorce settlement was untrue.

Moore's lawyer Heather Rogers said: "In fact there had been no bitter battle between Roger and Luisa Moore. They had agreed an amicable financial settlement last spring, shortly after the breakdown of the marriage."
In addition to apologising, the Daily Mail's publishers Associated Newspapers will pay the actor's legal costs.

For the newspaper, lawyer Nicki Schroeder said the article, which appeared last January, was based on information from a freelance agency which had been supplied in good faith and the Mail had not realised it contained inaccuracies.
However, the newspaper now accepted it contained false statements and apologised.
